name: Diffusion in Solids
summary: Explains how atoms move through solids, the mathematics of Fick's laws, and why diffusion controls heat treatment, doping and high-temperature behaviour.

topics.name: Diffusion mechanisms: vacancy, interstitial, interstitialcy and exchange
Fick's first law and steady-state diffusion
Fick's second law; error-function solutions for semi-infinite solids
Thin-film (Gaussian) and diffusion-couple solutions; carburising and doping profiles
Temperature dependence: Arrhenius behaviour and activation energy
Atomistic theory: random walk, jump frequency and correlation effects
Diffusion in alloys: interdiffusion, Darken's equations and the Kirkendall effect
Chemical potential as the true driving force; uphill diffusion
Short-circuit paths: grain-boundary, dislocation-pipe and surface diffusion
Diffusion in ionic crystals and semiconductors; ionic conductivity
Diffusion in polymers and permeation of gases
Numerical solution of diffusion problems with finite differences
